translate_en|mods/FootballMod/common/med:
The base amount of stamina that is drained before the fitness calculation begins 
(Recommended to not make this higher than 0.05 as stam drains from 1 to 0 and going into a big group of zomboids can drain stam very quickly with a high base)
Whether stamana drain occurs when the player attempts to push over a zomboid (off), or only when a player succeeds (on).

How much fitness is subreacted before the fitness reduction begins;
 equation-> Base Stamina / max(1, fitnessLvl - fitnessSubtractor)
Decides whether the player must be sprinting in order to activate the chance to shove over a zomboid.
Determines how much each strength skill point contributes to increasing the chance of shoving a zombiod
Subtracts from the strength level before multiplying by the Coefficent (strengthlvl - strengthSubtraction) * strengthCoefficent
How much a someone with the football player perk multiplies the reduction of the chance of being tripped.
Decides how much holding a football contributes to being able to push over a zomboid (via addition and can be in either the primary or secondary slot).

Adjusts how directly you must be moving toward a zomboid to trigger a tackle (0 means any direction, while 1 would mean directly infront of you, with the cone of influence getting bigger as the number decreases).
Determines how much each nimble skill point contributes to reducing the chance of being tripped
How much having the Football Player perk adds onto the chance of you being able to knockdown a zomboid.
If greater than 0, will make the chance to knockdown a zomboid constant at the number provided, ignoring the strength or football player checks.
Limits Head-On Vector to sprinters (maintains difficulty). If unchecked, applies to all zomboids.
Controls how much more likely you are to knockdown a zomboid when sprinting rather than regular running.

Reduces the likelyhood of tripping when running or sprinting at zombies.
Increases the chance of knocking down a zombie when running or sprinting at them. 
Removes all clothing related discomfort.
